items.source: By default, arguments to the locations or value attribute will be processed using a GroovyBeanDefinitionReader for resource locations ending in ".groovy"; otherwise, an XmlBeanDefinitionReader will be used to parse Spring <beans/> XML files. Optionally, the reader() attribute may be declared, allowing the user to choose a custom BeanDefinitionReader implementation.
items.translation: 默认情况下，locations 或 value 属性的参数将使用GroovyBeanDefinitionReader进行处理，适用于以".groovy"结尾的资源位置；否则，将使用XmlBeanDefinitionReader来解析 Spring <beans/> XML 文件。此外，可以可选地声明reader()属性，允许用户选择自定义的BeanDefinitionReader实现。

items.source: Like @Import, this annotation provides functionality similar to the <import/> element in Spring XML configuration. It is typically used when designing @Configuration classes to be bootstrapped by an AnnotationConfigApplicationContext, but where some XML functionality such as namespaces is still necessary.
items.translation: 与 `@Import` 类似，此注解提供了类似于 Spring XML 配置中`<import/>`元素的功能。它通常用于设计由`AnnotationConfigApplicationContext`引导的`@Configuration`类，但此时仍需要某些 XML 功能（例如命名空间）。

items.source: By default, the reader will be adapted to the resource path specified: ".groovy" files will be processed with a GroovyBeanDefinitionReader; whereas, all other resources will be processed with an XmlBeanDefinitionReader.
items.translation: 默认情况下，读取器将适配指定的资源路径：`".groovy"` 文件将由 `GroovyBeanDefinitionReader` 处理；而其他所有资源则将由 `XmlBeanDefinitionReader` 处理。

items.source: The configured BeanDefinitionReader type must declare a constructor that accepts a single BeanDefinitionRegistry argument.
items.translation: 配置的 BeanDefinitionReader 类型必须声明一个接受单个 BeanDefinitionRegistry 参数的构造函数。

items.source: Supports resource-loading prefixes such as classpath:, file:, etc.
items.translation: 支持资源加载前缀，如 classpath:、file: 等。

items.source: Consult the Javadoc for reader() for details on how resources will be processed.
items.translation: 有关资源处理方式的详细信息，请参阅reader()的Javadoc。

items.source: BeanDefinitionReader implementation to use when processing resources specified via the locations or value attribute.
items.translation: 处理通过locations或value属性指定的资源时使用的BeanDefinitionReader实现。

items.source: Resource locations from which to import.
